description.p: Imladris is a native Linux polyglot document studio and scientific Markdown editor built with Vala, GTK4, Libadwaita, GtkSourceView 5, and WebKitGTK 6.0. Featuring an adaptive ribbon interface, Imladris provides a distraction-free writing environment for technical authors, data scientists, and researchers.
Whether editing Quarto research reports, R Markdown statistical documents, or Jupyter notebooks, Imladris renders mathematical formulas, tables, and charts in real time.

ul.li: Categorized Launch Modal: 9 creation targets across multi-file projects (Standard and Sandboxed) and standalone simple files
Sandbox Dependency Engine: Isolated environments with renv for R and venv for Python
The .mallorn Exchange Format: 1:1 bidirectional compatibility with RStudio projects and portable single-file bundles
OpenDocument Export Pipeline: Headless export to ODT and ODP presentations
Adaptive Modern Ribbon: High-density GTK4 and Libadwaita tabs for Home, Insert, Computation, Publish, and View with linked controls and quick collapse (Ctrl+F1)
Real-Time Live Preview: WebKitGTK 6.0 preview with KaTeX mathematics, Mermaid diagrams, and syntax highlighting
Dual AI Co-Author: In-editor writing assistant with support for local offline models and cloud LLMs
Model Context Protocol (MCP): Built-in MCP server integration for agentic document analysis and data retrieval

description.p: Note: This application is independently developed and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Posit, RStudio, or Project Jupyter.

description.p: Release v0.23.0 delivers a comprehensive GNOME/Libadwaita interface overhaul, redesigned Elrond AI copilot and code assistance, new workspace customization options in Preferences, and rock-solid WebKitGTK 6.0 preview rendering:

ul.li: GNOME & Libadwaita HIG Redesign: Streamlines the welcome view with progressive disclosure, providing high-visibility Quick Start cards (Quarto Notebook, R Script/Shiny, Open Folder) alongside a collapsible expander for specialized templates (.Rmd, .ipynb, .Rproj, .mallorn).

Zero-Chrome Distraction-Free Empty State: Automatically conceals toolbar ribbons, document tab bar, and bottom status bar on startup or when all tabs are closed, maximizing screen estate and visual clarity.

Redesigned Elrond AI Copilot: Features a new active provider status pill in the chat header, multi-context chips (Active File, Selection, Data, Last Error), formatted inline Markdown with Pango markup, and interactive code action cards (Insert at Cursor, Run in Console, Copy).

Unified Local & Cloud AI Engine: Automatically routes prompts through local ElrondEngineController when available, seamlessly falling back to configured cloud providers (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, Ollama, LM Studio) or Antigravity harnesses.

Preview-First Inline Assistance: Re-engineers the Ctrl+Shift+E editor prompt popover with quick-action pills (Fix & Clean, Add Comments, Explain, R Plot) and a live monospace preview box with one-click Replace Selection or Insert at Cursor.
Decluttered 4-Pane Workbench Dock: Replaces crowded quadrant header buttons with clean maximize and overflow popover menus for minimizing, undocking, and quadrant rearrangement.

Preferences Workspace Controls: Adds dedicated settings for 4-Pane Studio vs. Focus Mode layout, ribbon toolbar visibility, bottom status bar visibility, and default editor zoom percentage with live-updating compact zoom controls.

WebKitGTK 6.0 Preview Stability: Eliminates blank preview panes across Wayland and GTK 4.18+ through DMABUF fallback handling, GL renderer standardization, ONDEMAND GPU policy, and base URI resolution.
Performance & Memory Safety: Resolves GLib.Bytes slice boundaries, asynchronous FIFO command queue deadlocks, and GObject singleton signal handler leaks.

description.p: Release v0.22.0 introduces hardware-accelerated rendering and a comprehensive GNOME/Libadwaita interface overhaul:

ul.li: Configures GTK4 GSK hardware acceleration (OpenGL NGL and Vulkan SPIR-V pipelines) via settings.ini before Display initialization with graceful CPU Cairo fallback.
Adds configurable animation and frame physics with three profiles: Alacritty Crisp (65ms zero-lag micro-transitions), PuTTY Instant (0ms zero-latency snap), and Libadwaita Smooth (180ms easing).
Introduces non-blinking steady terminal/editor cursor mode synchronizing across source editor and REPL consoles.
Implements Universal Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P / Ctrl+K) providing fuzzy-matched execution of workbench actions, statistical bridges, and hardware toggles.
Integrates inline code chunk execution runtime duration telemetry directly into document cards (Out [n]: ✔ ms/s).
Resolves Pango markup entities and unescaped ampersands across all preferences, popovers, and headerbars according to GNOME HIG standards.
Bundles 9 missing symbolic SVG icons directly into GResource (book-open, character-map, emblem-ok, format-text-superscript, send, software-properties, text-html, view-column, view-statistics).
Synchronizes GtkSourceView 5 syntax color schemes and dynamic styling with user-selected GNOME accent colors.

description.p: Release v0.21.0 introduces zero-latency, 100% offline VS Code-grade polyglot IntelliSense and intelligent bracket/quote pairing: Implements non-AI deterministic completion engine (CodeIntelliSenseEngine) with multi-paradigm symbol catalogs for R (base, stats, tidyverse, survival, DESeq2), Python (builtins, pandas, numpy, matplotlib, scipy.stats), Quarto hash-pipe (#|) cell options, YAML frontmatter directives, and LaTeX/mhchem math macros; features live buffer AST scanning for user-defined variables and functions, active REPL session object introspection, and dataframe column accessors (df$col); adds VS Code subsequence fuzzy scoring with prefix boost; integrates BracketAutoPairController for smart auto-closure of brackets (), [], {} and quotes "", '', ``, cursor overtype skip-over, and selection wrapping; provides manual completion invocation via Ctrl+Space; and includes preference toggles in SettingsManager.

Release v0.20.0 introduces the Elbereth Clinical Biostatistics, Power Calculation & Survival Studio with critical stability and workflow improvements: Adds Elbereth popover supporting ICH E9 sample size calculations (two-sample t-test, binomial proportions, and Schoenfeld 1983 log-rank survival) with live Cairo Power Curve plotting, regulatory SAP justifications, and automated R/Python verification chunks; integrates CDISC ADSL Table 1, ADTTE survival (Kaplan-Meier + Cox PH), subgroup forest plots, and differential expression volcano plots; resolves R Markdown comma-delimited chunk header parsing ({r, echo=FALSE}) and #| eval: false execution skipping; connects REPL-generated plots to Quadrant 4 Plot Gallery; fixes inline chunk output clearing and tab-delimited (.tsv) dataset imports; auto-generates cryptographic SHA-256 GxP provenance manifests on export; and adds clinical trial SAP and RNA-Seq starter templates.

Release v0.19.0 transforms Imladris into an enterprise-grade production workbench: Introduces Taniquetil (AlphaFold DB structural biology bridge) with native Cairo pLDDT per-residue confidence track and Bio3D/PAE code generation; integrates Yavanna Bio-Entity & Oligo resolver; implements cryptographic SHA-256 GxP and EU CRA provenance attestation service (imladris-provenance.lock.json); resolves multi-thread MCP server memory safety through GLib MainContext marshaling; adds asynchronous FIFO execution queues to PersistentSessionManager eliminating G_IO_ERROR_PENDING stream collisions; and delivers vectorized 1,000-row pagination with column data type profiling in DataGridViewer.

Release v0.18.0 introduces the Arekyer Galaxy-to-Quarto Provenance Bridge, MathChemStudio, Rproj Project scaffolding, and Jupyter Notebook parity: Implements Arekyer (Imladris.Bridges.Arekyer) connecting upstream cloud bioinformatics histories to local reproducible documents with verifiable httr2 and pandas data loaders; integrates secure credential management via libsecret-1 OS keyring with isolated subprocess memory injection; adds MathChemStudio with natural syntax for mathematical and chemical formulas with dual-target LaTeX and Markdown export; enables creation and lifecycle management of native RStudio .Rproj project files; and establishes full feature parity across Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb) source structures.

Release v0.17.0 introduces the native Galaxy Project API & BioBlend Integration: Connects upstream bioinformatics cloud histories directly to the local workbench via asynchronous REST APIs; provides a dedicated Galaxy History Inspector in Quadrant 3 with live dataset state tracking (ok, running, queued, error); implements single-click reproducible code chunk generation into active Quarto (.qmd) and R Markdown (.Rmd) documents for R (httr) and Python (requests and pandas); adds a Libadwaita Galaxy authentication preferences dialog with instant server validation; and hardens credential storage according to GDPR Article 25 and EU Cyber Resilience Act standards.

Release v0.16.0 delivers comprehensive codebase deduplication, optimization, and stability refactoring: Eliminates redundant and dormant code across ExportService, RibbonFactory, and ChunkExecutionEngine; refactors DocumentPage buffer change debouncing and snapshot caching to eliminate redundant string memory copies; introduces pre-compiled regular expressions for Markdown formatting and Shiny URL parsing; optimizes Flatpak host runtime resolution to avoid duplicate IPC roundtrips; secures DataGridViewer column lifecycle against UI thread blocking; and improves multi-language code block detection across Julia, SQL, Bash, TypeScript, and Python.

Release v0.15.2 introduces complete R Shiny interactive web application support matching RStudio workbench capabilities: Real-time Shiny app detection across app.R, server.R, ui.R, and inline reactive notebooks; context-aware HeaderBar 'Run App' / 'Stop' execution controls with Ctrl+Shift+A shortcut; multi-target display engine supporting the embedded Viewer Pane in Quadrant 4, a dedicated standalone Adw.Window, and the user's default external browser; dynamic ephemeral port allocation and stdout/stderr stream interception; and built-in modern bslib sidebar Shiny templates accessible from the primary menu and welcome dashboard.

Release v0.15.1 incorporates deep GNOME architectural debugging and stability improvements: Resolves GObject circular reference memory cycles in citation completion; secures code chunk signal disconnections with try-finally execution guards; adds graceful persistent session shutdown routines to eliminate zombie subshell processes; guarantees stream and descriptor closure in REPL bridges; adds non-blocking timeout wrappers for binary checks; harmonizes license declarations to GPL-3.0-or-later; and resolves GTK4 widget class compiler warnings.

Release v0.15.0 delivers full functional parity with RStudio across the 4-quadrant workbench docking system: Introduces interactive Command History tracking with project-level .Rhistory synchronization, readline Up/Down navigation, and history export; adds the dedicated History panel (Quadrant 3) and Packages manager panel (Quadrant 4) with live library attach/detach toggles; upgrades Plots to a multi-plot gallery deck with Previous/Next navigation, zoom popout window, image/PDF export, and clipboard copy; adds complete Files workspace actions (New Folder, New File, Delete, Rename, and Set Working Directory); integrates the Help documentation browser with R Rd2HTML pipeline; refines Environment categorization into Data (with 1-click View), Values, and Functions with live search and CSV/text dataset import; and implements cell execution controls (Run Chunks Above, Clear Console) with custom keyboard shortcuts.

Release v0.14.1 resolves critical live preview display and application crash issues, and introduces direct Pandoc-powered document exports: Fixes GLib-GIO file opening crash by implementing HANDLES_OPEN and application open hooks; resolves Gtk.IconTheme display singleton assertion crash; resolves WebKit WebProcess crash loops and pane width squashing on laptop displays; hardens WebKit local file access and sandbox configuration; adds native Pandoc HTML (standalone with embedded resources) and PDF export pipeline with graceful fallback renderers; and sanitizes Pango markup escaping across preferences and plugin views.

Release v0.14.0 introduces three major workbench pillars: (1) R and Python Global Environment Management with broom clear confirmation, dynamic object querying, and an interactive virtualized Dataframe & Matrix Viewer backed by GtkColumnView and GioListStore with View(x) hooks; (2) Customizable detachable workbench layout engine supporting 2x2 Quad, Left Tall, and Right Tall topologies, standalone floating window undocking and automatic re-docking, and layout preset persistence in ~/.config/imladris/layouts/; and (3) Integrated Elrond AI Copilot tab in the bottom-left quadrant with context toggle chips (+Active File, +Dataframe Schemas, +Last Error), streamed chat history, and one-click 'Insert at Cursor' and 'Run in Console' code actions.

Release v0.13.1 brings critical security hardening, memory safety, and live preview rendering fixes: Resolves WebKitGTK 6.0 inner bwrap sandbox credential handshake collisions in Flatpak (WEBKIT_DISABLE_SANDBOX_THIS_IS_DANGEROUS=1) ensuring reliable live preview; adds base URI directory resolution for relative images and stylesheets; introduces automatic WebProcess crash recovery; hardens plugin ID validation against directory traversal and blocks symlink expansion during archive extraction; secures workspace file access against path traversal; optimizes real-time word counting to zero-allocation streaming; cleans up deprecated Libadwaita expander row icons; and implements application window close resource cleanup.

Release v0.13.0 introduces an Obsidian-style JavaScript Extension & Plugin Engine powered by JavaScriptCore (JSC.Context): Enables lightweight, isolated JavaScript plugins with onload/onunload lifecycle hooks; provides declarative imladris bridge exposing native toasts, dynamic ribbon buttons in the Extensions ribbon group, safe GtkSource.Buffer read/insert actions, gated R and Python console execution, and Elrond AI queries; supports one-click bundle imports (.implugin and .zip) with permission and GPLv3 license consent modals; and adds an Extensions management page in Preferences.

Release v0.12.2 delivers the complete Conventional Software Architecture and Engineering Audit refactoring: Eliminates dormant proto-code and uncalled methods in MallornManager and ElrondEngineController; resolves GObject lifecycle memory retention across document tabs via Adw.TabView close_page hooks and explicit signal disconnection; fixes syntax language mapping for .qmd files in GtkSourceView; eliminates whole-document string duplication in frontmatter parsing; resolves nested block formatting in basic_markdown_to_html; optimizes host command generation; and synchronizes MCP server protocol metadata.

Release v0.12.1 resolves container exit 127 issues and streamlines multimedia insertion: Transitions Elrond AI into a robust Smart Local Server & Agent Harness Bridge supporting Ollama (:11434), LM Studio (:1234), Cherry Studio / LocalAI (:23333 / :8080), and host Antigravity CLI (agy); introduces an interactive file picker dialog for images and videos with automatic asset copying to the project's /img subfolder in sandboxed projects; supports format-aware Quarto video shortcodes and HTML5 video rendering in live preview; and adds an About Imladris dialog with documentation links, ecosystem credits, and Gemini Assistance acknowledgment.

Release v0.12.0 introduces major enhancements across AI architecture, GNOME 51 integration, and layout flexibility: Reworks the internal llama.cpp engine with soname symlink preservation, Flatpak host fallback, and 60-second health handshakes; modernizes UI spinners to Adw.Spinner with GNOME 51 platform targeting; adds user preferences for inline AI editing popovers and dynamic Left/Right side panel docking; bundles official vector SVG brand logos across all frontier and local AI models; and publishes the full architectural blueprint and bug localization matrix.

Release v0.11.0 delivers enhanced UX controls and comprehensive performance optimizations: Introduces an intuitive 3-stop slider (Low, Medium, High) for Elrond Assistance Level, automatic host distribution detection displaying tailored llama.cpp installation commands across Debian, Fedora, Arch, openSUSE, Solus, and NixOS, and dual backend switching between Vulkan and NVIDIA CUDA. Also includes major codebase deduplication and performance tuning, caching telemetry size calculations, extracting the standalone PackageIndexCache service, and removing dormant legacy code.

Release v0.10.0 introduces the unified 'Write with Elrond Assistance (AI)' zero-configuration local copilot and telemetry status bar monitor. Features automatic Qwen2.5-Coder-3B model bootstrapping, zero-setup llama-server lifecycle management with Vulkan GPU offloading and CPU fallback, real-time RAM/VRAM telemetry polling every 2 seconds, editor context menu action and Ctrl+Shift+E shortcut. Also introduces the dedicated top 'Packages' Ribbon Tab with live prefix autocomplete, ETag disk caching, O(log N) binary search, pak and uv fast-path installation, and automatic sandboxed lockfile synchronization.

Release v0.9.0 introduces the Automated micromamba Data Science Toolchain Manager and 4-tier runtime resolution hierarchy (Project Sandbox → Managed Global Toolchain → Host Flatpak Spawn → Host Native). Provides one-click automated installation of R 4.4 with dev compilers, IRkernel, pre-compiled tidyverse, Python 3.12 with uv, and Quarto CLI into user storage ($XDG_DATA_HOME/imladris/toolchains/) with zero root permissions and zero host compilation errors. Enables completely self-contained execution on clean Linux installations inside Flatpak containers.

Release v0.8.0 introduces transparent host R interpreter discovery and execution support inside Flatpak sandboxes via the flatpak-spawn host portal, shared host-sandbox cache directory (~/.cache/imladris) for graphics plots and temporary scripts, and real-time package compilation log streaming to the interactive console pane.

Release v0.7.0 brings the complete 11-pillar expansion, modernized Libadwaita Ribbon menu with 5 consolidated high-density tabs and collapsible deck (Ctrl+F1), appearance theming with GNOME default accent colors, and a vastly expanded AI Assistant subsystem: First-class support for Google Gemini (AI Studio and Google OAuth token), Claude (Anthropic Messages API with thinking blocks), OpenAI (GPT-4o, o1, o3-mini), Cursor API compatibility, NVIDIA NIM cloud endpoints, DeepSeek (including DeepSeek-R1 reasoning stream extraction), Kimi (Moonshot AI), Qwen (Alibaba DashScope), Ollama, and LM Studio local server with persistent user credentials; clean launch modal with clean UI labels, context-aware ribbon state machine, RStudio-style package installer for CRAN and PyPI, interactive R and Python persistent consoles with inline chunk output cards and plot rendering, automatic pwd synchronization, sandboxed project engine with RStudio and Jupyter export, 1:1 DCF parity for .mallorn bundles, and headless ODT/ODP pipeline.

Release v0.6.0 introduces the 6 core pillars: Categorized creation pop-up dialog with 9 creation targets, sandboxed vs standard project engines (renv and venv isolation), the 1:1 RStudio-compatible .mallorn exchange format, and comprehensive ODT and ODP OpenDocument export pipelines.
Release v0.5.1 standardizes the canonical Flatpak and Freedesktop Application ID to io.github.Antux912012.Imladris and includes the Phase 1.1.3 RStudio 4-Quadrant Drag-and-Drop Docking System.

Release v0.5.0 introduces dynamic UI morphing (GNOME Apostrophe distraction-free mode and RStudio 4-quadrant workbench), full multi-format adapters (.md, .qmd, .rmd, .ipynb), atomic crash recovery with shadow buffer caching, and 5 interactive Smart Ribbon popovers.
Release v0.4.0 with AI co-authoring assistance, polyglot auto-completion, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration.
Release v0.3.0 featuring WebKitGTK 6.0 live preview, KaTeX math rendering, and multi-format export.
